Strategy
OP-Moderate Fund is a balanced fund investing its assets in the global fixed-income and equity markets. In the base scenario, the fund invests 70% of its assets in the fixed-income markets and 30% in the equity markets. The proportion of fixed-income investments may range between 50–90 % and equity investments between 10–50 %.
